name: lumen-design-system
description: Lumen — a calm, minimal design system for React (web / Next.js) and React Native, inspired by the clarity of iOS.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @lumen/tokens && npm run build -w @lumen/icons && npm run build -w @lumen/react && npm run build -w @lumen/react-native
scripts.typecheck: npm run build && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present && tsc -p tsconfig.examples.json
scripts.test: npm run build && node scripts/smoke-test.mjs && node scripts/check-skill-snippets.mjs
scripts.docs: npm run build -w @lumen/tokens && npm run build -w @lumen/icons && node scripts/build-specs-md.mjs && node scripts/build-skill-refs.mjs
